Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---] [-]F AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 2.00gms, die axis: 12
